name: Rod Cutting Problem
description: Maximizes revenue from cutting a rod of length n into pieces, given prices for each length. Classic unbounded knapsack DP.
aim: Find optimal cut points to maximize total price: dp[i] = max revenue from rod of length i using dp[i] = max over j: price[j] + dp[i-j].
howItWorks: For each rod length i from 1 to n:
Try all cuts j from 1 to i

whenToUse: Unbounded item selection with length constraint
alternatives: Greedy — doesn't work: optimal substructure requires DP

inputHint: Each number is the price for that length, so the rod is as long as the list.
